subject.title: fix(sessions): enforce exact owner equality for all parent session use

question: Should plugin-runtime callers fail closed when a parent or existing target is ownerless, even if that rejects legacy plugin workflows that previously reused such sessions?
rationale: Exact equality provides the strongest isolation and matches delete behavior, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for legacy ownerless session rows and therefore needs explicit gateway/security ownership.

options.title: Keep exact equality
options.body: Reject foreign-owned and ownerless parent or target sessions for plugin-runtime callers, with current-head proof documenting the upgrade boundary.

options.title: Design a migration path
options.body: Pause merge and define a trusted doctor or ownership migration before enforcing the restriction on legacy ownerless rows.

recommendation.title: Keep exact equality
recommendation.body: Reject foreign-owned and ownerless parent or target sessions for plugin-runtime callers, with current-head proof documenting the upgrade boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the gateway session lifecycle and product behavior changed by this security boundary.
